bandReport.notes: Band covers Q64-Q91 contiguously across printed pages 21, 23, 25, 27 (PDF indices 10-13); the booklet renders only the English pages, so printed page numbers advance by 2. Q64 opens at the top of p10's left column and is complete; p09 (previous band) ends with Q60 (left column) and Q63 (right column), both complete with their own option blocks, so nothing spills into my band. Q91 ends above the footer of p13's right column and is complete; p14 (next band) opens with Q92 (left) and Q95 (right), so nothing of mine continues overleaf. NO shared code block / Directions run anywhere in this band - every one of the 28 questions prints its own four options directly beneath its own stem in the same column. Page 13 has visible whitespace after Q88 in the left column and after Q90 in the right column; that is layout, not a missing question - the numbering is unbroken. Neighbouring-band content seen in passing: p09 Q63 is a CPI/'housing' classification item (Economics), p14 Q92 is Parliamentary Privilege and Q95 is the Radcliffe Line. Note two near-neighbour questions that share option vocabulary but are distinct: Q68 lists 'Integrated Teacher Training Programme' as its option (a) while Q70 asks which programme IS an integrated teacher training programme; both transcribed as printed.
